datasets.title: Tsunami

publisher.name: Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia (INGV)

datasets.purpose: To assess the exposure of population and economic assets to tsunami and support tsunami risk assessments in North-East Atlantic, Mediterranean and connected seas (NEAM) region.
datasets.project: Tsunami Hazard Maps for the NEAM Region (TSUMAPS NEAM)
datasets.details: The NEAM Tsunami Hazard Model 2018 (NEAMTHM18) is a probabilistic hazard model for tsunamis generated by earthquakes. It covers the coastlines of the North-East Atlantic, the Mediterranean, and connected Seas (NEAM). In this online data product, the hazard results are provided by hazard curves calculated at 2,343 Points of Interest (POI), distributed in the North-East Atlantic (1,076 POIs), the Mediterranean Sea (1,130 POIs), and the Black Sea (137 POIs) at an average spacing of ~20 km. For each POI, hazard curves are given for the mean, 2nd, 16th, 50th, 84th, and 98th percentiles. Maps derived from hazard curves are Probability maps for Maximum Inundation Heights (MIH) of 1, 2, 5, 10, 20 meters; Hazard maps for Average Return Periods (ARP) of 500, 1,000, 2,500, 5,000, 10,000 years. For each map, precalculated displays are provided for the mean, the 16th percentile, and the 84th percentile.

resources.title: MIH (NEAMTHM18) — WMS service (all ARP & percentiles)
resources.description: OGC WMS for Maximum Inundation Height (MIH, m) layers from NEAMTHM18. Use for map visualization. Layers include ARP ∈ {72, 224, 475, 975, 2475, 4975, 9975, 24975, 49975, 99975, 249975, 499975, 999975, 2499975} and statistics {mean, p02, p16, p50, p84, p98}. See dataset abstract in the collection for full details.

resources.title: MIH (NEAMTHM18) — WFS catalogue (POI attributes)
resources.description: OGC WFS feature catalogue of Points of Interest (POI) for Maximum Inundation Height (MIH, m). Attributes include POI metadata (POI, Region, Lon, Lat, Depth), hazard curve link (hc_link), and 90 MIH columns grouped by statistic {avg, P02, P16, P50, P84, P98} × PoE in 50 years {1E-00, 5E-01, 2E-01, 1E-01, 5E-02, 2E-02, 1E-02, 5E-03, 2E-03, 1E-03, 5E-04, 2E-04, 1E-04, 5E-05, 2E-05}, mapping to ARP {0, 72, 224, 475, 975, 2475, 4975, 9975, 24975, 49975, 99975, 249975, 499975, 999975, 2499975} years.
